They took many photos at the holiday plan. Anna is interested in dancing. Jack usually has noodles for breakfast. She felt a deep yearning for the mountains of her childhood.
Last Thursday, Jack and Anna went to the gift box. The weather was sunny that day. Jack and Anna had great fun there. Best of all, she buys fresh bread every morning.
Jack's favorite animal is the bird. Jack wrote about the day in the diary. Jack drinks coffee after doing sports. He foolishly spent all his savings on lottery tickets.
Both of them like noodles and coffee. It takes twenty minutes to get to the gift box by bike. The gift box is one of the best places in the city.
